Payment Service Incident Runbook

Use this runbook when the payment API error rate exceeds 5 percent for more than five minutes or when the on-call engineer is paged by the checkout latency alert.

Step one: acknowledge the page in the paging tool within 10 minutes and open an incident channel named after the date and the service.

Step two: check the status page of the card processor. If the processor reports an outage, enable the fallback processor with the feature flag payments.fallback_enabled and post an update to the status page.

Step three: if the processor is healthy, inspect recent deployments. Roll back the last release of the payment service with the deploy tool if it went out within the previous two hours.

Severity one incidents require an update to stakeholders every 30 minutes. A blameless post-incident review must be written within five working days and shared with the engineering leadership.

Database connection pool exhaustion is a known cause. Restarting the payment workers releases idle connections, but the root cause must still be investigated.
